description: This file defines authentication API routes for user registration and login using FastAPI. It includes route handlers, database interactions, password hashing, and token creation.

classes.name: User
classes.description: User model representing users in the database

methods.name: UserOut register_user(payload: RegisterRequest, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Handles user registration by creating a new user record in the database.

methods.name: TokenResponse login_user(payload: LoginRequest, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials and returns an access token upon success.

ctags.name: login_user
ctags.pattern: /^async def login_user(payload: LoginRequest, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session)) -> Token/
